The Sufi tradition, a mystical branch of Islam, highlights the idea of "jalal" and "jamal," which can be translated as 'the glory of God' and 'the beauty of God', respectively. "Bakht" symbolizes the expression of "jamal," the ecstatic and blissful experience of the divine's beauty.
